desc: Establish the weighted monotone-DAG recurrence and rolling-DP correctness oracle.
Confirm that the current oracle passes both public samples.
Identify and repair the omitted non-adjacent touched-cell transitions in the correctness-first block decomposition.
Derive a linear-size planar compressed DAG for a connected walk-shaped touched set.
Prove the compressed network size and total block/query complexity under \(HW,Q\le 200000\).
Implement the optimized algorithm with transposition, revisits, endpoint cells, and zero values.
Validate the optimized implementation against the rolling-DP oracle on public and randomized tests.
